source.source_statement: Source Snapshot Manifest: ZIP entry、前身repository exact 2件のidentity、namespace policy、advertisement A/B digest、全ref→peeled object→commit/tree→entry edge、sealed mirror receipt、現行HELIX symbol/doc/testを固定し、観測時刻、source/tree digest、取得器・抽出器versionを記録。ref/content/edge分母はreceiptから導出し、remote identity・advertisement・namespace・source集合が変われば既存snapshot、atomization、coverage receiptをstale化する。

conditions.condition_by_condition_current_compariso: 採択HARNESS-L2/L11-038 (fixed digests dd5b... / dfa3...)は選択source scope内の一意capability identity、manifest分母、双方向join、aggregate-only closure拒否を保持。採択OS-015/016はsource identity/revision/digest/authorityとunknown/stale traceを保持。いずれも指定ZIP+旧repo 2件のA/B advertisement、all refs/object/tree/entry edge、sealed mirror capture、receipt由来3分母、extractor drift stale cascadeを実データで成立させる契約/receiptではない。
conditions.exact_positive_negative_oracle: 正例: manifestが指定3 source class、全advertised refs/content/edges、A/Bとsealed receiptを一revisionで束縛し、分母がreceiptから導かれる。負例: remote identity/advertisement/namespace/source setまたはextractorが変わればsnapshot・atomization・coverageをstale化し、部分/重複/旧currentを成功扱いしない。HAC-HIL-09a/b/cとHAT-HIL-09は設計statusのみ。
conditions.residual_or_nonclosure: FR21の個別 capture + HIL-09 input completeness/evidence は既存採択pairへ完全対応せず、current mainで採択済みHIL-09 exact capture receipt/acceptance evidenceは未確認。隣接038/015/016の一般保証はFR21具体的な収集成立と同一視しない。

source.source_statement: 各抽出capabilityへ一意ID、disposition (adopt/harden/redesign/reject/absorbed)、根拠、HIL要件、基本設計、test、detector/gateの双方向joinを要求し、未判断/根拠なきreject/孤立atom/複合ID一括合格があればpair-freeze拒否。

conditions.condition_by_condition_current_compariso: 採択HARNESS-038は選択されたmanifest内の個別capability内容閉包、disposition意味、要求・設計・検証対との双方向join、未説明/孤立/aggregate-onlyの失敗oracleを扱い、PO row 43採択の固定L2/L11 section digestと一致。採択OS-016は要求→作業/実装/検証state/traceとunknown/stale edgeを保持。OS-016は個別capability disposition ledgerを規定しない。
conditions.exact_positive_negative_oracle: 正例: 選択manifestの各atomにdecision rationaleと各downstream relationを明示して全方向から到達。負例: pending、根拠なしreject、orphan、multi-ID aggregate passのいずれかが1件でも残ればfreeze拒否。038の採択はsemantic closure条件、実行済みHIL09 ledger/receiptではない。
conditions.residual_or_nonclosure: selected scope内容閉包部分はHARNESS-038へ保持される。一方FR22が明示する各source capabilityのdisposition列挙、根拠付きreject、全HIL requirement/design/test/detector/gateへの一つずつの双方向joinとpair-freeze拒否の実証はHIL09固有の実receiptとしては未確認。

conditions.condition_by_condition_current_compariso: 現行OS-L2-112/L11-112候補は、明示選択されたversioned read registration、source identity/type/key scope、connector/schema/mapping revision、credential reference、classification、read/write policy、sync mode、owner、enabled stateとenable/disable receipt、secret値の非保存を具体化する。FR23のselected IR atomを含むMPR-RC-HELIXOS-L2-112-001 source set/receiptに結ぶ。ただしcandidate sectionは明示未採択、MPR authority_effect:none。OS L1親の採択はL2-112の採択でない。
conditions.exact_positive_negative_oracle: 正例は選択scope/revision/policy/contract/digest/owner/enabled stateと既存操作authorityへの参照を束縛したregistry/enable-disable receipt、secret value 0。負例はcredential value保存、unknown/stale contract/policy/authority、digest不一致やscope外でenabled stateを変えない。112 L11は静的候補oracleのみ。
conditions.residual_or_nonclosure: 候補本文の記録shapeはFR23条件に対応するがPO採択、formal successor/owner transfer/product scope/consumer set、実connector操作または受入結果はない。採択OS-015等の一般 source/authority recordだけではProduct Data connector registry意味は成立しない。

source.source_statement: Product Data Ingestionがfull/incremental snapshotを冪等取得し、source record→canonical entity→requirement/design/Issue mapping、provenance、freshness、tombstone、schema driftをread projectionへ投影。snapshot/watermark/mapping edge/stale-drift findingを示す。

conditions.condition_by_condition_current_compariso: 現行OS-L2/L11-112未採択候補はselected source/scopeに限定してfull/incrementalを別modeとして扱い、source key・connector/schema/mapping revision・snapshot/cursor/watermark・canonical entity/selected consumer mapping edge・lineage/freshness/redactionをrevision束縛。same input idempotency、tombstoneとfull-missing/incremental-missing差、schema drift/partial/cursor regression時のcurrentを進めないoracleを記す。HARNESS-038は旧FR24 ingest/canonicalizationを明示的にscope外とするため代替ではない。
conditions.exact_positive_negative_oracle: 正例は同一選択scopeでのfull/incremental snapshotおよびcanonical mappingsを再送して二重効果なし。負例はschema drift、cursor逆行、partial result、unknown lineageでcurrent/watermarkを前進しない。explicit tombstoneは関連mapping stale、incremental単なる不出現は削除でない。未見source/consumer契約はunknownを保持。
conditions.residual_or_nonclosure: 候補は意味条件を静的に保持するが未採択で、formal successor/owner/product scope/consumer set/導入版は未決。実snapshot/watermark/mapping edge、external read、runtime/HAT合格は存在を主張しない。

conditions.condition_by_condition_current_compariso: 採択OS-L2/L11-033 exact pair is adopted by PO-57 row56, MPR-RC-HELIXOS-L2-033-001 and pinned section digests 580778... / 1d303... . It individually registers selected engine and detector capabilities with owner/version/config/compatibility and snapshot/scope/revision, separates artifact from finding receipt, records run/artifact/output digest/exit status and replay result, rejects unknown/mismatch/partial/provenance gaps and quarantines differing reruns. Old ZIP implementation is not carried as physical requirement.
conditions.exact_positive_negative_oracle: 正例: selected engine capabilities using same input snapshot, version/config rerun deterministically; each run has artifact digest/exit status and provenance. Negative: unknown version/compatibility, snapshot mismatch, only subset rerun, artifact/finding collapsed, missing evidence, partial run or changed digest cannot be replay success. L11 exact pair preserves oracle; execution not asserted.
conditions.residual_or_nonclosure: FR25 selected capability/versioned-run evidence is retained in adopted 033 within its selected scope. It does not establish runtime/test acceptance, all historical capabilities selected, or formal successor binding/source holding release. FR25 is in the 7-atom set; HIL-NFR-13 is explicitly outside that atom set and remains pending. Carry-forward row 58 remains successor_requirement_ids empty.
